# Netlify Pricing

## Plans

### Free — $0 forever
- **Audience:** Individual
- **Credits:** 300 credit limit
- Deploy from AI, Git, or API
- Private by default until you publish
- Unlimited deploy previews
- Build with Agent Runners
- Add Custom domains with SSL
- Functions & AI models
- Store structured data with Netlify Database
- Store files & images with Blob storage
- Firewall Traffic Rules & basic rate limiting
- Global CDN

### Personal — $9//month
- **Audience:** Individual
- **Credits:** 1,000 credits
- Everything in Free, plus:
- Smart secret detection
- 1-day observability
- Priority email support

### Pro — $20//month with
unlimited members
- **Audience:** Team
- **Credits:** 3,000 credits
- Everything in Personal, plus:
- Private organization repos
- Shared env variables
- 3+ concurrent builds
- 30-day analytics & metrics

### Enterprise — Custom pricing
- **Audience:** Team
- **Credits:** Unlimited
- Everything in Pro, plus:
- 99.99% SLA
- Enterprise network tier
- High-performance builds
- SSO & SCIM
- Log drains
- Organization management
- 24/7 dedicated support

## Credit Packs (Auto Recharge)

| Plan     | Credits | Price |
|----------|---------|-------|
| Personal | 500 | $5 |
| Pro | 1,500 | $10 |

## Usage Credit Costs

| Feature             | Cost                  |
|---------------------|-----------------------|
| Production deploys  | 15 credits each       |
| AI inference        | Varies based on AI model |
| Compute             | 10 credits per GB-hour |
| Bandwidth           | 20 credits per GB     |
| Web requests        | 2 credits per 10k requests |

## Credits-to-USD Calculator

Based on the Pro credit pack rate: **$10 per 1,500 credits** ($0.00667 per credit).

| Credits | USD     |
|---------|---------|
| 1       | $0.01   |
| 10      | $0.07   |
| 100     | $0.67   |
| 500     | $3.33   |
| 1,000   | $6.67   |
| 1,500   | $10.00  |
| 3,000   | $20.00  |
| 5,000   | $33.33  |
| 10,000  | $66.67  |

### Per-Feature USD Cost

| Feature             | Credits | USD Cost                |
|---------------------|---------|-------------------------|
| Production deploys  | 15      | $0.10 each              |
| Compute             | 10      | $0.07 per GB-hour       |
| Bandwidth           | 20      | $0.13 per GB            |
| Web requests        | 2       | $0.01 per 10k requests  |

> Prices calculated at the Pro credit pack rate of $10 / 1,500 credits.
> AI inference costs vary by model — see https://docs.netlify.com/manage/accounts-and-billing/billing/billing-for-credit-based-plans/pricing-for-ai-features/#pricing-per-ai-model
